system.description:
Touch; one surface or object, 5ft across. Inscribe a glyph (powdered diamond and incense, 200 gp, consumed) that triggers when a creature you did not name crosses or opens it, dealing 1d8 per two levels thunder damage (max 5d8) in a 5ft radius; Reflex halves. Lasts until triggered or 1 day per level; found with a Search check vs spell DC.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin
